# P34.26 — ADR-124 allow dispositions: the verb, the census, the owed row

**Requirement ids:** **SIG-TRUST-006** (publication gate) ·
**SIG-ONTO-013** (an org with no external identifier keeps its flag —
never exposed) · **SIG-PUB-002** (person-name screen always; persons
never allowed — ADR-163) · **SIG-STORE-011** (INSERT-only
dispositions) · **Base:**
`r11/P34.24b-sqitch-l44-52-clone-rehearsal` (stacked; merge after
P34.24b) · **Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/231_P34.26__adr-124-allow-dispositions.md` (manifest row
231 — Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) · **Gate:** **G2-ADR124 +
D-K2-1 [A-10] — auto-allow + absence only** (ADR-159, decided
2026-10-01): allow organisations matched to Census of Governments /
SAM UEI / Wikidata QID, the person-name screen always runs, every
other org types `not yet reviewed`, **no operator review queue**. ·
**Live stage:** read-only census over `sig-pg`, executed
2026-10-04T15:43Z (outside 03:00–06:30Z, no concurrent materializer).

## Why

ADR-124's publication gate had no scripted way to record an `allow`
under ADR-159's registry auto-allow rule, and no committed census of
the review-flagged organisations. This ticket ships the INSERT-only
verb and the read-only census so P34.46 can apply allows with the
Round-10 schema and every other organisation shows a typed
"not yet reviewed" state — never an implicit allow.

## What this ships

**`sig-ops disposition record`** — `record --allow --from
<sig.disposition-list/1> [--dry-run (default) | --apply] --authority
<ADR-159 rule + registry id> --decided-by <role|rule token>`:

- **Dry-run by default.** Without `--apply` the verb verifies every
  entry against the spine and prints the `sig.disposition-plan/1` it
  *would* record — and writes nothing.
- **INSERT-only.** The one write path is
  `db.dispositions.record_disposition` → the P32.5 append-only
  registry (`decided_at` stays `clock_timestamp()`-defaulted — the
  single server clock authority, ADR-124 family). No UPDATE/DELETE
  route exists anywhere in the change; the immutability trigger test
  stands.
- **Fail-closed typed refusals** — `person_entity` / `not_an_organization`
  / `target_missing` / `org_status_denied` / `current_deny_disposition`
  / `no_registry_match` / `identifier_provenance` /
  `person_name_screen`. A spine-asserted registry identifier is the
  tier-0 match record (ADR-159 (a)); its asserting claim must reach an
  `ingestion_permitted` source (item 6). The person-name screen runs
  on the label, the matched registry name and the literal party
  values (K2 §3.4); screened text is never echoed.
- `--authority` and `--decided-by` are both required; `--decided-by`
  must be a role or rule token — a personal name cannot validate.
- DSN via `SIG_DISPOSITION_DSN` env only — never argv.

**`sig-ops disposition census`** — the read-only
`sig.org-census/1` report of every `publication_review_required`
organisation: K2 organisation-edge degree + edge share, materialized
degree, external identifiers held, registry match (permitted-source
asserted only), person-name screen result, `current_disposition`,
typed `adr159_outcome`, and the `D-R11-ADR124-1` obligation column.
Emits `CENSUS.md` + `CENSUS.csv` + `census.json` + `allow-list.json`
(the `sig.disposition-list/1` over `auto_allow_eligible` rows —
**P34.46 applies it**, P34.26 applies nothing). `--role` issues
`SET ROLE` for the hosted leg; the connection pins
`default_transaction_read_only=on` so the leg carries zero writes by
construction. Label-bearing identifier schemes (`sig.org.name` &c.)
are **counted, never listed** — a committed file never carries the
withheld name. No review queue is emitted.

## The live result — executed, not queued

Census ran **live on `sig-pg`** 2026-10-04T15:43Z through
`cloud-sql-proxy` → `sig` → `SET ROLE sig_read_public` +
read-only transaction (no dedicated read-only LOGIN exists yet —
P34.43 owns; the session role is the contract's fallback). Hosted
head is `camera_site_human_decisions`: `publication_disposition` is
not yet deployed there (lands with P34.46) — the record says
`disposition_registry_present: false` honestly.

Re-measured, never pinned (K2 NEW-1):

- flagged organisations: **1,559** (K2 said 969)
- edge denominator: **43,662** distinct (subject, org) pairs
- top-50 degree share: **92.6 %** (K2 said 96.5 %)
- person-name screen flags: **5**
- **ADR-159 registry matches: 0** — the only identifier scheme any
  flagged org carries on hosted is `sig.org.name`. `allow-list.json`
  is empty; all 1,559 rows type `not yet reviewed`. Widening the
  allowable set is P37.46a/b's registry intake; P34.46's apply leg
  has an honest empty list from this census.
